routes.title: Free SEMH Tools — Sensory, Behaviour & Pupil Voice Checklists
routes.description: Free SEMH questionnaire tools that run entirely in your browser. Complete a checklist and download the results as a CSV. No account, no data sent anywhere.
routes.summary: Free questionnaires for sensory, behaviour and wellbeing, for teachers, SENCos and other practitioners. No account needed, nothing is uploaded: everything stays in your browser and you download your results as a CSV.

routes.title: Free Sensory Profile Checklist for Schools | SEMH Tools
routes.description: A free sensory checklist for practitioners. See which sensory areas stand out, get practical strategies and build a sensory circuit. No account, nothing uploaded.
routes.summary: Tick the statements that sound like the young person and see which of 22 sensory areas stand out across over-responsive, under-responsive and sensory-seeking patterns. Choose strategies for the areas that matter most and build a simple sensory circuit. Free, with no account, and your answers stay in your browser.

routes.title: Free Behaviour Function Checklist for Schools | SEMH Tools
routes.description: A free school behaviour checklist that explores the possible functions of a pupil's behaviour (control, attention, escape, sensory, self-esteem), with linked strategies.
routes.summary: Rate how often behaviours happen in school to explore their possible functions: control, attention, escape, sensory and self-esteem. Primary and secondary versions, with strategies for the functions that stand out. Free, no account, nothing uploaded.

routes.title: Free Home Behaviour Questionnaire for Parents | SEMH Tools
routes.description: A free, parent-friendly questionnaire about behaviour and wellbeing at home, with practical advice for the areas that matter most. No account needed.
routes.summary: A parent and carer friendly check of behaviour and wellbeing at home. Answer a short set of questions and get practical advice for the categories that are worth looking at first. Free, no account, and your answers stay in your browser.

routes.title: Free Pupil Voice Questionnaire for Children | SEMH Tools
routes.description: A free, child-friendly pupil voice tool so a young person's own view of school is heard. No account, no ads, nothing uploaded.
routes.summary: A child-friendly questionnaire, completed by the young person, covering how school feels, what helps in the environment and how adults respond. Includes a 'my school day' activity and a classroom seat picker. Free, no ads, no account and nothing uploaded.

routes.title: Measure What Matters: Free Outcome Questionnaire Builder
routes.description: Build a printable 1 to 5 scale questionnaire from a bank of 35 SEMH outcome criteria and download it as a PDF. Free, no account needed.
routes.summary: Choose the outcomes that matter from a bank of 35 criteria, build a questionnaire and download a printable PDF form to track progress with a young person. Free and with no account.

routes.title: FAQs | SEMH Free Tools
routes.description: Answers to common questions about the free SEMH tools: how your data is handled, saving results, and how they relate to the full SEMH Toolkit.
routes.summary: How the free SEMH tools work, how your data is handled, how to save your results and how they relate to the full SEMH Toolkit.

routes.title: Privacy Policy | SEMH Free Tools
routes.description: How the free SEMH tools handle data: no accounts, no server-side storage, answers stay in your browser.
routes.summary: This site has no account, no server and no database. Every questionnaire runs in your browser and your answers stay on your device.

routes.title: Chronology Builder | SEMH Free Tools
routes.description: Turn a young person's written history into a clear visual timeline.
routes.summary: Turn a young person's written history into a clear visual timeline.
